title: The limit of 15 shop orders an hour is never tested on the server
what: The server refuses a member's 16th shop order in an hour, so one phone cannot empty the shelves. No server test places that many orders and checks the refusal. The phone test only checks that a refusal, if it came, would be said with words about the last hour and keep the bag.
expected: A server test places 15 orders for one member, sees the 16th refused, and sees a different member still able to order.
fix_line: Add a server check that the 16th order in an hour is refused and the bag is kept on the phone

title: The gym messages page with no internet is never tested
what: When the internet is off, the messages page should keep the last messages and say it is showing them. No test checks this. The no-internet line appears only inside test stand-ins that pretend to be the server, so nothing ever checks the page shows it, keeps the list, or avoids looking like 'No messages yet'.
expected: A test opens the messages page offline after a good load and sees the kept messages and the no-internet line, and with nothing kept sees no endless spinner.
fix_line: Add a test that loads the messages, goes offline, and checks the kept list and the no-internet line

title: No test checks what a phone sends to the new gym when it switches gyms
what: Switching from one gym to another should give the new gym only the typed name. No test looks at what is sent: the switch tests check only which calls were made and in what order, never their contents, and never that the old gym's plan or check-ins stay behind. No test checks the old gym's messages, plans and diets leave the phone after a switch, or stay after a failed one.
expected: A test switches gyms and checks the join carries only the code, the name and the join id, then checks the old gym's messages, plans and diets are gone (and kept when the switch fails).
fix_line: Add a switch test that checks what the new gym receives and what the phone keeps from the old gym

title: Starting the gym's workout of the day, and taking in a trainer's changed plan, are never run in a test
what: The tests read the trainer's workout of the day and plans as data, but the part that saves them on the phone is replaced by a stand-in. Nothing presses 'Start this workout', checks the routine lands once in 'Workouts of the day', checks 'Couldn't start the workout', or runs the plan sync that keeps the member's own changes when the trainer edits a plan.
expected: A test on a real phone database starts today's gym workout twice and sees one routine in the folder and the workout open, and syncs a changed trainer plan and sees the member's edited rows kept.
fix_line: Add real-database tests for starting the workout of the day and for syncing a changed trainer plan

title: The empty bag, 'Cancelling…' and the busy order button are never checked
what: No test opens the bag when it is empty, so 'Your bag is empty', its second line and 'Browse the shop' are never seen, and 'Place order' being off with nothing in the bag is checked only as data. 'Cancelling…' and the busy button while an order is sent are never checked either.
expected: A test opens an empty bag and sees the words and no working Place order, and a slow order or cancel shows the busy state.
fix_line: Add an empty-bag check and a slow-order busy check to the phone shop test
